title: DivineRPG Colourblindness FIx
description: Fix for DivineRPG (and maybe other mods) for colourblind people
body:
I made this resourcepack because I'm colourblind (mild deuteranopia) and I often confuse arlemite and realmite. Should work on any DivineRPG version lesser than 1.12.2 (inclusive).

Arlemite is gold ore but green (new ore texture), and realmite is orange redstone ore, also flipped vertically.
